levels.title: Deployment snippet

mission.title: YAML minimum
mission.brief: apiVersion apps/v1, kind Deployment, selector.matchLabels = template labels.

levels.template:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: web
spec:
  replicas: ____
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ____
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ____
hints: Label app=web in selector and template.

levels.title: Probe trap
levels.buggyCode:
livenessProbe:
  httpGet:
    path: /health
    port: 80
  initialDelaySeconds: 0
  periodSeconds: 1
options: port 80 ≠ app on 8080 + initialDelay 0 — probe fail → kill → loop
levels.explainOk: readiness = traffic; liveness = restart. Ports and delay must match the app.
levels.explanation: Interview: describe pod → Events → probe failed.

levels.title: Deployment or StatefulSet?
levels.instruction: Postgres in K8s: stable network ID + persistent volume per replica.
levels.question: Best workload controller?
options: StatefulSet + PVC (stable pod name, ordered deploy)
Deployment without volume — data in emptyDir
levels.explanation: Stateless app → Deployment. Stateful DB → StatefulSet or managed DB outside K8s.
